name: Fames

facts.text: Level 83, 100,000 health; the first Horseman. He speaks first, asks a raider whether they challenge fate, and on 'yes' grants two minutes to prepare.
The Horsemen come in order: Fames, then Bellum, Morbus and Funus, each a minute after the last falls; Funus calls Apocalypse. Each brings a fate's bearer.
Fames is Latin for 'hunger, famine'; Bellum 'war', Morbus 'disease', Funus 'funeral, death'.

story: Fames is the first of the four riders and the one who speaks for them. Famine in the old Roman tongue, though there is nothing starved about him: he has a scholar's patience and a gaoler's courtesy. He senses a crowd before it reaches the hall, he chooses one face out of it, and he asks the question every raid on Caer Sidi has to answer. Do you come to challenge fate? Say no, and he tells you to go and do what you were meant to do. Say yes, and he grants you a few grains of time, two minutes in your reckoning, to prepare. He is not cruel. He believes that a choice made with open eyes is the only kind worth punishing.
legend: Someone has to say yes to Fames. Then you get two minutes: buff, form up, pick targets. When he falls, Bellum comes a minute later, then Morbus, then Funus, then the big one. Do not waste the gaps; rebuff and rest.

aggro: I sense the presence of many, the presence of power and ambition.
